drafts.pattern: Tek asansör arızası ve onaylı alternatif varsa vatandaş kartını güncelle
drafts.proposed_rule_toml:
[[reflex]]
id = "R-101"
signal = "S1"
requires = ["oa_active"]
guards = ["alt_not_faulty_same_snapshot", "age_below_threshold"]
action = "publish_bound_alternative"
on_guard_fail = "E-05"
expires_days = 30
